tools.description: YAML-driven vulnerability scanner with 9000+ community templates for modern threat detection
tools.usage:
nuclei -u https://target.com -t cves/ -silent # CVE hunting
nuclei -l targets.txt -t exposures/ -severity critical # Exposure scan
nuclei -target https://api.com -t technologies/ # Tech fingerprinting
nuclei -u target.com -t misconfiguration/ -markdown-export report.md
